title: Step 68-C shared Admin Catalog read, detail and state foundation
description: Implement only the shared read-only Admin Catalog foundation after Step 68-B becomes canonical: typed server-side product list/detail and variant reads, opaque cursor pagination, local-only filtering of already loaded product rows, permission-safe/fail-closed states, and responsive Persian RTL presentation. Do not implement any Catalog mutation, product/variant lifecycle action, taxonomy mutation, media mutation/upload, sales-control apply, pricing/FX/Excel work, Backend/OpenAPI/database changes, Product Design changes, Storefront changes or Current-State closure.

dependencies.evidence: PR #362 merged after exact-artifact Project Owner approval; exact-SHA Canonical CI #1898, Phase A #1397, CodeQL #1047 and Storefront Quality #889 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6204157481.

acceptance_criteria.description: Admin Catalog reads use the canonical generated contract and existing Admin server auth bridge; no browser credential authority, raw customer cookie forwarding or parallel ad-hoc API client is introduced.
The product list consumes only the source-proven limit and opaque cursor query parameters, with default bounded page size; no server q/status/category/brand filter is invented.
Product filtering/search in Stage 68-C is client-local over already loaded rows only and is explicitly presented as such; it never alters the backend query or claims global-result completeness.

Authorized product list and product detail/variant read surfaces are Persian RTL, responsive and keyboard-accessible, with explicit loading/empty/error/denied/not-found states and request-id recovery information where available.

Product detail renders only authoritative response fields and does not fabricate absent descriptions, audit history, mutation availability, pricing edit authority, inventory edit authority or media-library authority.
Stage 68-C production code invokes no Catalog mutation endpoint and exposes no create/edit/publish/archive/restore/sales/taxonomy/media mutation control; those remain 68-D through 68-G.
Admin verification includes deterministic Stage 68-C type/static/build/read-boundary checks while preserving all inherited Step 67 acceptance gates.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review and exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release. Human Gate is not required for MEDIUM-risk 68-C.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 68-C is MEDIUM risk. No Human Gate is required. Stage 68-D remains blocked until 68-C terminal canonical closure.
